stem: Which room condition should be treated as part of biosecurity rather than only as a housekeeping issue?
choices: Standing water and accumulated crop debris
A whiteboard holding yesterday's completed task list in a dry area separated from plant material and work surfaces
A sealed container of clean gloves stored at the designated room-entry station for use during routine crop work
A labeled shelf of sanitized unused pots kept off the floor and separated from crop debris and incoming plant material
rationale: Standing water and accumulated crop debris can support pest or pathogen persistence and movement, so they are preventive biosecurity concerns rather than merely appearance or housekeeping concerns.
